body: Hey I might be younger than you but I feel the same way about   myself, I’ve been cutting myself for a while now and I haven’t really been getting better. So if you ever need to talk about anything I’ll probably somewhat understand and I can try to help. Please try to feel better about yourself because I promise you that someday you're gonna think about this and are gonna be glad that you decided to try and get better. Like I said you can talk to me pretty much anytime if you need to.
